name: Oak Meadows Marketplace
summary: Oak Meadows Marketplace is a community shopping center in Georgetown, Texas, managed by Phillips Edison & Company. Conveniently located on Williams Drive, it serves the growing northern Austin metro area with a mix of retail and service tenants for everyday shopping needs.
demographics: Oak Meadows Marketplace serves the growing Georgetown community in the northern Austin metro area, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $125,000. The trade area draws young professionals, established families with children, and active retirees who have relocated to this rapidly expanding suburb for its quality of life and proximity to Austin. Shoppers typically seek convenient, everyday shopping for groceries, services, and dining options, with a preference for national retailers and local businesses that serve daily household needs.
description: Oak Meadows Marketplace is a well-positioned community shopping center located at 5731 Williams Drive in Georgetown, Texas, serving the thriving northern Austin metropolitan area. Managed by Phillips Edison & Company, a nationally recognized shopping center REIT specializing in grocery-anchored retail properties, this center provides essential retail and service offerings to the rapidly growing Georgetown community. The center's strategic location along Williams Drive ensures excellent visibility and accessibility for residents throughout the area, making it a convenient destination for everyday shopping needs. As part of Phillips Edison's portfolio, Oak Meadows Marketplace benefits from professional management and a commitment to maintaining quality retail environments that serve local communities. The center represents the type of neighborhood shopping destination that has become increasingly valuable in suburban markets, offering a mix of national retailers and local businesses that cater to the daily needs of Georgetown's diverse and expanding population.
